title: Alert system card with 3-stage indicators and preview buttons
description: Implement web/src/components/AlertPanel.jsx displaying three distinct cards representing Stage 1 (Initial Alert), Stage 2 (High Alert), and Stage 3 (Critical Alert), highlighting the active stage, offering Preview Alert test buttons, and providing safe Acknowledge/Snooze controls.
acceptanceCriteria: Displays 3 cards: Stage 1 (Initial - Beep), Stage 2 (High - Voice Warning), Stage 3 (Critical - Alarm) (PRD 6.7)
Highlights the currently active stage with distinct borders and badge
Each card includes a 'Preview Alert' button to test audio and visual cues safely without drowsiness
Provides an 'Acknowledge / Snooze' button active during alert states
Explicitly notes that software does not control vehicle horn or lights (PRD 6.7)

steps.details: Create web/src/components/AlertPanel.jsx receiving activeStage and snoozeState.

steps.description: Implement preview alert and acknowledge handlers
steps.details: Connect Preview button to POST /api/alerts/preview; connect Acknowledge button to POST /api/alerts/acknowledge.
Style Stage 1 with yellow accent, Stage 2 with orange accent, Stage 3 with red accent. Add prominent 'Active' glow when active.
Run Playwright test clicking Preview button for Stage 1 and Stage 2; capture screenshot to .agent/screenshots/TASK-28-1.png.

technicalNotes: Never label alerts as controlling vehicle hardware.
Display sample voice prompt text directly in the card so users understand the intended message.
